cold_open.hook: Mark Zuckerberg just told staff AI agents are moving slower than he promised—and Meta's down 4.9% while Apple's up 4.84%.

markets.macro_note: Mega-cap rotation: AI hype cooling, Apple hardware strength, Tesla stumbling on delivery concerns.

big_story.story_title: Mark Zuckerberg tells staff that AI agents haven't progressed as quickly as he'd hoped
big_story.angle: Zuckerberg's public admission that his signature bet is behind schedule is a rare crack in the CEO confidence facade—what does it mean for Meta's capex roadmap and the broader AI arms race if the guy with the most compute is saying the math isn't working yet?

quick_hits.angle: Gold up for first week in a month as Fed rate-hike bets cool—the market is pricing in pause, not cuts, which is a subtle but real shift in expectations.

The politician who investigated Pegasus spyware got hacked with Pegasus spyware—a perfect irony that suggests either the spyware vendors have a sense of humor or the investigation was too close for comfort.
Ford's CEO is chasing 'flawless' vehicle launches after years of quality stumbles—the bar used to be 'don't catch fire,' now it's 'perfection,' which is either ambition or desperation.
Europe's top bankers and regulators are warning that AI is outpacing the rules—translation: we have no idea what we're regulating, but we're going to regulate it anyway.

odd_thing.joke_angle: A literary AI scandal twist—because apparently the only thing weirder than AI writing a book is the scandal around who wrote the scandal about the AI book.

yesterday_callback.topic: Meta's push into cloud computing means Wall Street has to prepare for lower margins
yesterday_callback.fresh_take: Today Zuckerberg admits the AI agents that were supposed to justify all that capex are moving slower than expected—so the margin hit is real, but the payoff timeline just got longer.

sign_off.callback_target: Zuckerberg's 'slower than hoped' admission—we'll see if Meta's next earnings call tries to spin it as 'strategic patience' or just owns the miss.
